game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on molten golems.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: In Ember Fields, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on molten golems. Each round, molten golems strike the lava bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the damage value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the lava bridge from molten golems in Ember Fields: keep the damage meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: damage drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ember Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Ember Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while damage > 0.
